name: Sample Clock
description: Reference plugin shipped with the kernel. Shows the manifest shape, the synchronous JS tool contract and the ctx capabilities, so a model that wants to extend the app has a working example to copy.
author: MyAgent

prompt.text: The sample-clock plugin is installed and provides `plugin_clock` (current local time + epoch ms). It exists as a reference implementation of the plugin format; do not delete it unless the user asks.

tools.name: plugin_clock
tools.description: Return the device's current local date/time and epoch milliseconds. Demo/parity probe for the plugin kernel.
